summary: Frontend-only smoke of Control Intelligence Mission Control (route /app/control-intelligence) and login rebrand. Logged in as jblan2026 admin, dismissed onboarding tour, exercised all 6 tabs, KPIs, panels, AI advisor, effectiveness search/filter, control detail modal, note posting, framework/evidence/remediation/defensibility panels, evidence-pack + control-log PDFs, executive brief + footer report PDFs, and refresh. issues:

action_items: OPTIONAL/COSMETIC: Tab data-testids use prefix `control-intel-tab-*` (e.g., control-intel-tab-mission) while KPI/panel testids use prefix `ci-*` (e.g., ci-kpi-total, ci-domain-effectiveness). Spec listed tabs as `ci-tab-*`. Recommend normalizing to a single prefix (either ci-tab-* or control-intel-tab-*) for consistency.
OPTIONAL: Ensure Auth headline is a single string (or set data-testid) so automated brand copy assertions can match 'Continuous Control Effectiveness & Assurance' contiguously.
critical_code_review_comments: ControlIntelligence.jsx (~290 lines): OK, well split into sub-dashboards.
useControlIntelligenceData.js correctly reports partial-source failures via sourceStatus without fabricating data — matches STRICT 'no mockups' directive.
MissionControlDashboard testids (`ci-*`) diverge from sub-dashboards testids (`control-intel-*`) — consider unifying naming convention.
Modal ControlDetailModal has close button but no Escape-key handler wired (Escape closes because backdrop click / DOM focus, but explicit onKeyDown for Escape would improve accessibility).
